# SØNA External Skill Pack

Curated, adapted skill references for SØNA's commercial workflow. These are concise adaptations, not verbatim copies of third-party repositories.

## Sources reviewed
- `social-media-skills/skills` — MIT. Used for trend-jacking, analytics, platform-native content and measurement principles.
- `sanic732/SunoForge` — MIT. Used for structured music-prompt construction and platform-neutral prompt engineering.
- `sonilo-ai/skills` — source reviewed for text-to-music/audio workflow concepts. Integration is optional and is not assumed to be installed or credentialed.

## SØNA rule
External skills provide methodology. SØNA remains the source of truth for product behavior, account data, tool availability and safety. Current facts must be verified at runtime; metrics are never fabricated.
